description: This file defines a React component named ImportModal that manages the import process for files within a web application. It handles file selection, parsing payloads, importing notes and tags, and updating UI state accordingly.

methods.name: reducer
methods.description: State reducer function handling actions for ImportModalState, including setting files, updating files, removing files, setting import tags, and clearing state.

methods.name: importFromPayloads
methods.description: Asynchronous callback to import payloads from a file, updating file statuses and dispatching success or error messages.

methods.name: parseAndImport
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the parsing of files, extracting payloads, importing them, and creating an import tag with metadata.

methods.name: closeDialog
methods.description: Function to close the import modal and optionally set the selected tag if available.
